notes: «كلاهما سمعه من، وراد» converges the two routes: Warrad and then Mughira are written once, so they form the shared tail
«كتب معاوية إلى المغيرة» is inside Warrad's story: Mu'awiya is in the scene (rule 5), Mughira is the one who answers and is the last link
«قال سمعته من» : Sufyan's two routes each start from him
